high_level_description: The image is a split-screen photograph featuring two different poses of the same person wearing an elaborate, vibrant pink lehenga with intricate floral embroidery. The lehenga is complemented by a matching dupatta draped over one shoulder. Left Side: The person is standing against a plain wall with a small green plant partially visible behind them. The background includes a piece of abstract art on the wall, which appears to be a black and white pattern. The person is posing with their hands clasped together in front of their chest, looking directly at the camera with a slight smile.
